description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for visually verifying the output of 'git log --graph' with various complex merge scenarios. It defines functions to check graph output, runs multiple test cases involving git commands, and compares graphical outputs, including colored versions.

methods.name: check_graph
methods.description: Function to produce a graph from standard input and compare it against expected output using 'lib_test_cmp_graph'.
